operation_details.item: The user uses paid search as one of their acquisition channels.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! How is the campaign planning going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It’s going well. I’m reviewing our acquisition mix and shaping the next campaign.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What channels are you using to bring people in?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use paid search, organic social, and email as acquisition channels.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives you a useful mix across paid, organic, and owned outreach. How are you comparing their performance?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I track channel performance in the growth dashboard so I can review the results alongside the campaign work.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Are you focused on a particular brand strategy or customer engagement goal for this campaign?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I’m focused on making the messaging consistent with the campaign strategy and improving customer engagement across those channels.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I use paid search, while keeping the organic social, email, and dashboard details.
